page.overview:
What is Alashan?

Alashan was a city located in the kingdom of Khazari within the Hordelands.

This important city sat along the banks of the Kuruk Muren river where the Silk Road passed through the western border of the country. Alashan was nestled into a pass where the steep Katakoro Shan mountains broke.

Alashan's position along the Silk Road caused great wealth to flow through the city. Many merchants and craftsmen called this city home.

Alashan's location offered strong natural defenses. In addition to these, strong fortifications were built, sheltering the city within from raiding horse bandits. A large gate house was complimented by towers located at each corner of the city, and a fortified palace dominated the center.
